title: AdvocateOutput
description: Shared output schema for the Rider Advocate and the Driver Advocate. Both sides use this exact schema; only the `side` value differs.

side.description: Must match the side you were assigned. Submitting the other side is rejected.

summary.description: One to three sentences summarising the strongest honest position for your side.

claims.description: May be empty if no claim is supported by the supplied evidence. An empty list is valid.

claimId.description: Unique within this output, e.g. R1, R2, D1.

claim.description: A single factual assertion. Must be supported by the cited evidence.

evidenceIds.description: Evidence IDs from the supplied context only. Never invent an ID.

policyRefs.description: Policy rule IDs from the supplied context only.

reasoningSummary.description: Why the cited evidence supports this side.

assertedFacts.description: Measured values quoted from the trusted context, so they can be verified.

disputedEvidenceIds.description: Optional. Evidence you consider unreliable or contested.

requestedOutcome.description: The outcome you advocate for. This is a position, not a ruling, and never a refund amount.

contextAcknowledged.description: Set true to confirm you reasoned only from the supplied context.
